sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define a 'Shadow Puppet' and explain the basic physical setup required to perform a shadow puppet show. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A shadow puppet is a flat cut-out figure placed between a bright light source and a translucent screen. The audience views the moving silhouette projected onto the screen.

questions.question_text: Identify the two most important health details that must be consistently recorded in a basic Family Health Handbook. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: It must contain personal medical histories, including known allergies or chronic illnesses, and a chronologically updated log of all received vaccinations and routine doctor check-ups.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain how the concept of machine learning helps an AI Assistant improve its responses over time. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Machine learning allows the AI to analyze past voice interactions and user preferences, enabling it to adapt its algorithms and provide more accurate, personalized answers continuously.

questions.question_text: Your class is organizing a 'Kaushal Mela' to exhibit handmade puppets. Outline a brief promotional strategy to ensure maximum student and parent participation in the event. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: Start by designing vibrant digital posters and distributing printed flyers a week prior. Next, make daily announcements during the morning assembly. Finally, send formal digital invitations to parents through the school communication portal, specifically highlighting the creative puppet shows scheduled.
